positive_example.input_summary_ru: Пользователь дает набор правил и просит выполнить работу в рамках этих правил.

positive_example.input_summary_ru: Multi-domain task has several responsibilities and review risks.
positive_example.chosen_ru: Keep branches separate, merge only after evidence/review, select reviewers before final formatting, and return only failed fragment to repair.
positive_example.rejected_ru: Collapse all responsibilities into one happy path or review only after final formatting.
positive_example.teaches_boundary_ru: OrchestrationReasoning learns branch separation, review-before-format and targeted repair.

negative_example.wrong_signal_ru: doc-07956 folder, node numbers, XIIGen title, branded phrases
negative_example.why_rejected_ru: These are provenance labels, not orchestration reasoning.

ablation_ru: Remove folder/title/node labels; chosen must survive on branch/review/repair boundary.

positive_example.input_summary_ru: Task elements have a main decision, dependent evidence and relation types.
positive_example.chosen_ru: Find root decision, attach dependent evidence/gates as children, then sequence/review according to relations.
positive_example.rejected_ru: Route because source file name or method names mention root/head/children.
positive_example.teaches_boundary_ru: Dependency structure as generalized orchestration relation model.

negative_example.wrong_signal_ru: .cs file, class names, method names, CoNLL-U relation tokens
negative_example.why_rejected_ru: These are implementation details and syntax shortcuts.

ablation_ru: Remove C# and CoNLL-U markers; chosen must still reason over root/dependent/relation.

positive_example.input_summary_ru: A complex task should move through ordered stations and carry evidence before claim.
positive_example.chosen_ru: Use a phase/gate chain: split, translate, plan, process/apply, translate result, select review, review, format; do not claim before review evidence.
positive_example.rejected_ru: Hardcode exactly nine nodes or use class/bridge names as the answer.
positive_example.teaches_boundary_ru: Evidence-carrying station chain with review before claim.

negative_example.wrong_signal_ru: class name, node ids, exact-nine count, Project15Bridge, SemanticCompiler29

ablation_ru: Rename phases and remove C# identifiers; chosen must still preserve station-chain reasoning.

positive_example.input_summary_ru: Reusable orchestration asset may be used concurrently and across batches.
positive_example.chosen_ru: Require isolation across runs, no state bleed, deduplication of duplicate work and independent evidence before readiness claim.
positive_example.rejected_ru: Accept because a test passes, because a singleton exists, or because the source says exactly nine nodes.
positive_example.teaches_boundary_ru: Claim requires isolation/dedup/no-cross-contamination evidence, not test-framework success.

negative_example.wrong_signal_ru: xUnit, Assert, test method names, temp paths, run ids

ablation_ru: Remove test framework and identifiers; chosen must still require isolation evidence.
